subject.title: feat(android): publish signed APKs with stable releases

question: Should this PR become the stable-release gate for signed standalone Android APK publication now?
rationale: The implementation is focused in the merge result, but it changes official release publication, signing custody, protected environment requirements, and the first live tag path in ways automation cannot approve on maintainer behalf.

options.title: Approve release-gate ownership
options.body: Merge after release/security owners accept that stable releases now require the protected Android APK workflow and first live tag supervision.

options.title: Require a rehearsal first
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers run an approved stable-like draft/tag rehearsal that proves upload, attestation, and release-contract checks end to end.

options.title: Defer official sideloading
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers want Google Play to remain the only official Android binary channel for now.

recommendation.title: Approve release-gate ownership
recommendation.body: Merge after release/security owners accept that stable releases now require the protected Android APK workflow and first live tag supervision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the PR commits and has the strongest visible Android/release-channel history for this decision.
